  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Jobs `orphan-workflows-test` (line 3921), `validate-standalone-test` (line 4694), `clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test` (line 4876) and `e2e-alt-model-test` (line 5190) set `GH_RETRY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS`, but none of their steps source `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` or use `gh_api_retry`.
  WHY: The setting has no effect, and it misleads maintainers into thinking these jobs have rate-limit protection. The source severity was MAJOR, mapped here to high. Three reviewers disagree: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash each said it is not a defect, because the workflow comments document it as intentional ("the bound is set for a future one").
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: "Route every read the gate makes through the existing rate-limit-aware helpers (`gh_retry`, `gh_read`, `_safe_gh_jq` in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh`)"
  expected_change_site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh (lines 642-646)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR does not change `scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh`, and its reads at lines 642–646 still use `gh_api_safe_quiet_print`. That helper's rate-limit handling (scripts/comprehensive_test_and_release_gh_api.sh:134-145) retries with fixed 30/60/120-second delays instead of waiting for the reported reset as `gh_api_retry` does. The contract test's scanner regex matches only `gh api`/`gh run`/`gh pr`/`gh issue` directly, not `gh_api_safe_quiet_print`, so this site gets past it without an allowlist entry or a routing change. The last run diff did not touch this file. Disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say this was accepted earlier as a NIT / won't-fix (judge decision entry 8) and is allowlisted with reasons.

- requirement: "Route every read the gate makes through the existing rate-limit-aware helpers."
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, step "Phase 3b1: Apply force-review label to smoke PR."
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The label lookup at line 1776 is still a raw `gh api` read. It does not go through a retry helper and has no allowlist entry.
- requirement: "Add a contract test that fails when one of the five step scripts or the gate workflow contains a raw `gh api` ... read outside an explicit allowlist."
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_gh_rate_limit_routing.py`, `raw_reads()` and `_is_raw_read()`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The scanner joins backslash-continued lines, then checks for write flags across the whole rest of a matched command. In the force-review step at `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1776-1781`, the raw GET is followed by a continued `gh api` POST with `-f` flags. `_is_raw_read()` therefore classifies the GET as a write, and the unallowlisted read gets past the contract test.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
